entityDescription: Aerial Tools ApS (AT) is a Copenhagen based deep tech start-up that develops a revolutionary Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) with a patented payload interface unit. The drone performs vertical take-off and landing, giving the same flexibility in operations that conventional drones. The advantage of this type of drone is that it does not need a large area to reach its operational height or any supporting mechanism like run aways or catapults. The drone is larger than many drones with a wingspan of 4 meters, designed to carry up to 3 kg payload-weight, which is more than most standard drones (about 1.5kg), making it flexible to carry out different kind of activities. By tilting the rotors, it flies forward taking advantage of its aerodynamics. Thereby, it can continuously fly for a long time (4 hours/flight opposed to 20-40 mins for most standard drones) without battery replacement or charging. AT’s drone platform can cover large and remote areas with high data quality acquisition. The patented payload interface unit is designed to plug and play any advanced specialized sensor as well as multiple sensors at the same time to collect data more efficiently and precisely than current drone solutions. The aim is to improve aerial data acquisition in B2B commercial inspections and monitoring. Therefore, the product is designed to improve the overall operational capacity, providing a better end user customer experience, reducing operational mapping costs, and facilitating better and quicker customers decision making. AT services depend on the customer needs. To offer customers exactly what fits into their operational needs, we provide tailored data acquisition, processing, and analysis. Our final goal is to create an impact by developing scalable, accessible, and sustainable solutions.

MultiPull One is a mobile, flexible, pocket-sized training station that makes heavy and bulky steel weights superfluous and makes you completely independent of gravity. An electric motor converts the energy from a high-performance battery unit into up to 80 kg of pulling force - and the power of your muscles back into electrical energy. The device itself weighs only 5 kg. The battery stores excess energy charges your mobile devices and can be easily removed for use as a power bank. With the help of the versatile mounting options, you can train not only at home, but also in the park on a tree or a lamppost, whether for endurance or highly efficient strength training.
In addition, MultiPull One will be the world's first fitness device that allows users to train together remotely, feeling each other. Interactive live challenges in the community, such as digital tug-of-war, are made possible by the app, which is the central control unit.
